title: A New 'Transformers' Movie Is Coming, With Steven Spielberg's Help
summary:
Get ready for more giant robots! Paramount Pictures is working on an eighth "Transformers" movie, the film news site IndieWire reports.

The "Transformers" movies are based on Hasbro toys. The toys are robots that can change into cars, trucks and other machines. The movies have earned about $5.4 billion around the world.

Famous filmmaker Steven Spielberg has joined as an executive producer. He will help guide the movie's ideas, along with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura. Spielberg signed on after reading the script.

Writer Jason Fuchs wants the new film to feel like the original movies. It will take place in modern times. The story is still a secret.

Michael Bay directed the first five movies. He is in early talks to direct again, but nothing is final. Shia LaBeouf, who starred in the first films, will not come back.

A planned movie mixing "Transformers" and "G.I. Joe" is not moving forward.
why_it_matters: Fans of giant robot toys and movies may soon get a new adventure to watch.
